name: week
title: This week at the school
subtitle: What needs attention, the booking sheet and the fleet. Rendered by npm run view.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Bookings with a problem, flights not graded, students gone quiet, accounts, medicals, checks.
sections.sql: select kind,record,due,detail from v_attention order by due nulls last,kind,record

sections.title: Booking sheet
sections.sql: select code,booked_on as day,starts,ends,kind,student,aircraft,instructor,lesson,problems from v_schedule where status='booked' and booked_on between current_date and current_date+6 order by booked_on,starts

sections.title: Fleet
sections.sql: select code,type,status,hours,hours_to_check,annual_due,open_defects,deferred_defects from v_fleet order by kind,code

name: training
title: Training progress
subtitle: Every active student against the syllabus and the flight test.

sections.title: Students
sections.sql: select code,name,course,instructor,lessons_done,lessons_total,next_lesson,total_hours,solo_hours,days_since as days_since_flying from v_students where status='active' order by course,lessons_done desc

sections.title: Flight test
sections.note: Ready means syllabus, hours, exams, medical and account are all in place.
sections.sql: select student,name,course,case when missing='' then 'ready' else missing end as still_to_do from v_test_ready order by missing<>'',student

sections.title: Instructors
sections.sql: select code,name,category,hours_7d,hours_28d,students,not_graded,booked_7d from v_instructor_load order by hours_28d desc

name: compliance
title: Compliance
subtitle: Every rule in docs/compliance.md checked against the records.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,record,issue from v_compliance order by rule,record
